name: codex-ambient
description: Local animated backgrounds and live preview for the Windows Codex app. Requires Codex background mode (local debugging).

interface.shortDescription: 動態背景與即時預覽 · Animated backgrounds
interface.longDescription: Windows 本機背景工具，支援極光、海洋、星空、影片與中英文預覽。外掛會自動啟動本機背景服務；Codex 仍須以背景模式啟動。Local Windows background controls with automatic helper startup. Requires Codex launched with local debugging; does not restart Codex or patch its files.
defaultPrompt: 開啟 Ambient 背景預覽
把 Codex 背景換成極光
